feed.title: UK News - The latest headlines from the UK | Sky News

articles.title: England striker Ivan Toney set to face trial during Euro 2028 over alleged assault
articles.summary: England striker Ivan Toney is set to face trial over an alleged assault in the summer of 2028, during the European football championships.

articles.title: Overweight offshore workers 'could lose their jobs' under new rules
articles.summary: Hundreds of offshore workers could be at risk of losing their jobs when a new weight limit comes into effect next month, an industry body has warned.

articles.title: Knifeman on train had 'greatest delight on his face', court told
articles.summary: A man who stabbed 10 people on a London-bound train "had the greatest delight on his face" and was "loving every single moment" of the attack, a court has heard.

articles.title: Police to examine Thomas Markle's digital devices after child sex abuse image claims
articles.summary: Police in the Philippines have been handed a warrant by a court to start examining digital material alleged to contain child sex abuse images belonging to the Duchess of Sussex's father, Thomas Markle Snr.

articles.title: Hospital staff suspended over 'inappropriate access' to Southport attack records
articles.summary: Two hospital staff members have been suspended over potential instances of inappropriate access connected to the Southport attack.

articles.title: Social media watchdog sets out age verification plans ahead of under-16s ban
articles.summary: Social media age checks could help protect under-16s from inappropriate online content, but some children may find ways round them, Ofcom has said.

articles.title: Family tribute to 'loving grandfather' killed in double fatal crash
articles.summary: The family of one of two men killed in a multi-vehicle collision in West Lothian have paid tribute to the "gentle and loving husband, father and grandfather".

articles.title: Profits up billions at both UK's biggest mortgage provider and major oil producer
articles.summary: The UK's largest mortgage lender has seen profits nearly double as customers pay higher interest rates.

articles.title: Trump warned $10bn BBC lawsuit could be dismissed
articles.summary: Donald Trump's $10bn (£7.5bn) defamation lawsuit against the BBC could be dismissed unless he turns over documents requested by the broadcaster, a US court has warned.

articles.title: Poundland closer to collapse as it files notice to appoint administrators
articles.summary: Poundland has filed notice to appoint administrators, bringing it one step closer to collapse.
